channel.title: The Grant Desk - Design, EU, next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Design, EU, next 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
3 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Professionalisation and Practice Development 2026
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 17 Sep 2026 · EUR 8,250 to EUR 28,250 per applicant. Total budget EUR 300,000, increased for 2026. No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Design Sector Internationalisation Grant Scheme 2026
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · EUR 10,000 to EUR 50,000. Minimum 20 percent co-financing. Round budget EUR 300,000 (2026 total EUR 600,000). No application fee.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Platforms for Design-based Learning 2026
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 75,000 per application, from a total budget of EUR 720,000. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
